consumer: The salvage-contract/mission completion check asking 'has the required quantity of scrap been satisfied yet?'
scope: The contract's required-item collection scope (the counted inventory the objective tracks), not just ground stacks on nearby map tiles
decisive_source: src/arcopolis_export.cpp::write_entities (items) — iterates points_in_radius/in_export_window and dumps each tile's raw get_map().i_at(p) stack with charges/count_by_charges into JSON, i.e. raw ground-item simulation state in a spatial window
divergence: Scrap already collected into the player's inventory or sitting on a tile outside the export window: the contract predicate reads satisfied, but the nearby-tile item dump shows the scrap absent (and conversely, unrelated loose scrap on a nearby tile not counted by the contract inflates the reconstructed answer)
